title: 欧洲配额设限：比亚迪吉利加速本地化，短期销量承压如何应对？
speaker: Yu Chen-Deng

segments.en: Yeah, so I would say overseas expansion will remain the Chinese EV companies, especially the leader company.
segments.zh: 我认为海外扩张仍将是中国电动车企业，尤其是龙头企业的重点。

segments.en: But the structure might change a little bit. Given the recent last day's European plugging hybrid, hybrid quota.
segments.zh: 但结构可能略有变化，鉴于近期欧洲的插电混动配额政策。

segments.en: So basically, most of the company has been reacting as in accelerating their local production, especially in Europe.
segments.zh: 基本上，多数公司已在反应，加速本地生产，尤其是在欧洲。

segments.en: BYD is ramping up their hungry plant as of now.
segments.zh: 比亚迪目前正在提升其匈牙利工厂的产能。

segments.en: And also, Gili and for talking about joint venture production and both are accelerating.
segments.zh: 吉利也在洽谈合资生产，两者都在加速。

segments.en: But we would say last day's Euro quota, basically set a hard limit.
segments.zh: 但我们认为，欧洲的最新配额基本上设定了硬性限制。

segments.en: So we do see near term volume will probably took a hit, but into the mid to long run, our company is already working on accelerating localization
segments.zh: 因此，短期内销量可能受到冲击，但中长期看，公司已在加速本地化以减轻影响。

segments.en: to mitigate that impact. What do you think is probably doing the best in terms of international expansion right now out of the EV makers that you cover?
segments.zh: 在你覆盖的电动车制造商中，目前谁在国际扩张方面做得最好？

segments.en: Yeah, I would definitely highlight BYD and Gili.
segments.zh: 我肯定会强调比亚迪和吉利。

segments.en: So the overseas has been growing faster.
So for BYD, I think the current round rate this year, they probably oversee volume, probably shooting towards 1.9 million.
segments.zh: 所以对于比亚迪，我认为今年这轮销量可能瞄准190万辆左右。

segments.en: We're seeing about 2.5 million next year. And they are also talking about a quarter of that, probably more coming from the local production.
segments.zh: 我们预计明年约250万辆，其中约四分之一可能更多来自本地生产。

segments.en: So I think the volume has been strong. Also, the structure has shifting more focus from pure export from China towards local production.
segments.zh: 所以我认为销量一直强劲，结构也在从纯中国出口转向本地生产。
